benchmarkSuites.scope: Native Rust storage engine microbenchmarks for BTree, WAL, recovery and transaction paths.
Browser SDK, Web Worker, WASM, OPFS and IndexedDB comparison workloads.
Regression visibility against a prior benchmark-baseline artifact.

commands: cargo bench --workspace --offline --locked (interrupted during the final BTree case)
notes: Native Rust Criterion timings and browser SDK/OPFS timings measure different layers and must not be compared as equivalent paths.
Browser rows are normalized from packages/sdk/bench/results raw JSON; skipped rows are omitted from regression comparison metrics.
The Rust step is a benchmark compile gate by default; pass --run-rust when a local machine is intended to execute Criterion timings.
All three commit benchmark commands were repeated after the store-name fix; unaffected BTree, WAL and recovery measurements were retained.
